sql_templates.description: Fetch signal outcomes for the current quarter.
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_date AS (
                SELECT MAX(date_resolved) AS max_date
                FROM signals.signal_log
            ),
            quarter_signals AS (
                SELECT *
                FROM signals.signal_log
                WHERE date_resolved BETWEEN (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') AND (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
            )
            SELECT 
                symbol, 
                signal, 
                hit_target, 
                hit_stop, 
                return_pct
            FROM quarter_signals
            WHERE date_resolved IS NOT NULL;

sql_templates.description: Join signal logs with stage snapshots to evaluate current scores.
sql_templates.query:
SELECT 
                sl.symbol, 
                sl.signal, 
                sl.return_pct, 
                ss.stage, 
                ss.technical_score, 
                ss.investment_score
            FROM signals.signal_log sl
            JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON sl.symbol = ss.symbol
            WHERE ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
            AND sl.date_resolved IS NOT NULL;
